content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods
content_sections.text: National Rural Livelihoods Mission Karnataka operates under Sanjeevini - KSRLPS to implement livelihood promotion activities across rural blocks and clusters. This recruitment aims to fill a Block Manager position in Maddur taluka of Mandya district to support farm livelihoods and agricultural initiatives.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods post in Mandya district (Maddur taluka). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the required educational qualification and age limit to apply for the Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods post. M.Sc. (Agri) and allied sciences of farm sector with minimum 01 years of field level work experience in relevant field or B.Sc. (Agri) and allied sciences of farm sector with minimum 03 years of field level work experience in relevant field or Any other Master degree with minimum 05 years of field level work experience in farm livelihoods or relevant field. 3+ Years of Experience in relevant field. The age of applicants must be between 18 years and 45 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate for the Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods post will receive a consolidated remuneration of 25000.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods Job Description
content_sections.text: Implementation of farm livelihoods related activities at block level in all aspects of Farm livelihoods. Supporting Mahila Kisan in all aspects of Farm livelihoods. Maintaining coordination within Block and Cluster level activities Farm livelihoods. Coordination with other line departments for Convergence at block level. Submission of periodical reports as per the instructions of district and state authorities. Monitoring and support for the activities of the farm livelihoods CRPS through regular field visits. Identify and document best practices in farm livelihoods initiatives. Ensuring data collection and entry into MIS for monitoring and evaluation of farm livelihoods activities. Support the all activities under Farm Livelihoods in development of protocols, package of practices for organic farming. Also, facilitate workshops consultations necessary for developing the same. Identifying institutional buyers / local buyers, conducting buyer seller meets. Any other tasks assigned by the higher authorities of the Mission.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NRLM Karnataka Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods
content_sections.text: Go to the official NRLM Karnataka Job Portal. Create a free account or log in to access the application system. Sign in to submit your application before the deadline of 29 October 2026.
